summary: NewGenIvf Group Limited, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing an Amendment and Exchange Agreement dated August 11, 2026 with an institutional holder. The company issued a new senior convertible note with $7,105,468.75 aggregate principal in exchange for existing convertible notes and related warrants from 2024 and 2025 purchase agreements. A concurrent Leak-Out Agreement restricts the holder's sales of shares issuable upon conversion. This debt-for-debt exchange and leak-out restriction indicates liability management aimed at reducing overhang and extending terms. No pricing, premium, or board advisors were disclosed. Watch for dilution impact and conversion activity.
